name: UNO

setup.text: Everyone draws a card; the highest number deals. Action cards count as zero.
Shuffle and deal 7 cards to each player.
Put the rest face down as the draw pile and turn its top card over to start the discard pile.
If the first card is a Wild Draw Four, put it back in the deck and turn another. Other action cards take effect.
The player to the dealer's left goes first.

turn.summary: Match the top discard by number, colour or symbol, or play a Wild.
steps: If you cannot play, draw one card. If that card is playable you may play it at once; otherwise your turn ends.
You may choose not to play a playable card, but then you must draw, and you may only play the card you drew.
When you are down to one card, say 'UNO'.

end: A hand ends when one player has no cards left. Hands continue until someone reaches 500 points.

scoring.text: The player who went out scores the cards left in everyone else's hands.
Number cards score face value. Draw Two, Reverse and Skip score 20 each. Wild and Wild Draw Four score 50 each.
Alternative: each player keeps a running total of the points they are caught holding; when someone reaches 500, the lowest total wins.

missed.text: A Reverse acts like a Skip, and after playing a Skip or Reverse you play again straight away.
After a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, the turn comes straight back to you.
Wild Draw Four may only be played when you hold no card matching the colour of the discard pile. Holding a matching number or action card does not stop you.
A Wild Draw Four can be challenged by the player who must draw. If it was played illegally, its player draws 4. If it was legal, the challenger draws 6.
If the last card played is a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, the next player still draws, and those cards count in the scoring.
You can only be caught for not saying 'UNO' between your second-to-last card touching the pile and the next player starting their turn.
Playing a wrong card or suggesting a play to someone costs 2 cards.
